C18 has related reassignment-and-qualification reasoning, while C17 concerns a Joint Chiefs assignment but is chiefly retrospective thanks rather than an appointment communication.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"to permit your appointment at my direction as the succeeding Chief of Naval Operations","parent_excerpt":"your willingness to assume the post of Administrator of the Defense Production Administration effective June 1, 1952, succeeding Mr. Manly Fleischmann","explanation":"Both letters formally describe the recipient's assumption of a senior position and expressly identify it as a succession."},{"child_excerpt":"it is in the best interest of the United States that you should bring your long experience in naval matters, and most importantly, your N.A.T.O. experience","parent_excerpt":"it is my feeling that in so doing it will be possible to bring under your direct guidance all production phases of the mobilization program","explanation":"Each justifies the appointment by connecting the recipient's experience or leadership to a broader national administrative need."},{"child_excerpt":"Let me give you every assurance of my personal satisfaction in making this appointment.","parent_excerpt":"This appointment carries with it my appreciation of the tireless efforts you have given to the mobilization effort","explanation":"Both conclude the operative appointment discussion with a personal presidential endorsement tied directly to the appointment."}]}
